local.heading: Matthews is a small town that Google treats like part of Charlotte.
paragraphs: Matthews sits in the southeast corner of Mecklenburg County. Charlotte wraps around it on the northwest and southwest, Mint Hill borders it to the northeast, and Stallings in Union County sits just past the southeast line. Search for a roofer or a CPA from a kitchen in the 28105 ZIP code and Google pulls results from all four places, plus a long list of Charlotte firms that claim to cover everywhere. A local company has to tell Google plainly where it works.

The town started as a stagecoach stop between Charlotte and Monroe and earned the nickname Stumptown for the tree stumps left after land was cleared for cotton. The railroad arrived in December 1874, and the town incorporated in 1879. That old core is still downtown along Trade Street, and the town is now putting money into it: a streetscape project from McDowell Street to Matthews Street and more than 100 new parking spaces, including the Heritage Lane lot.

Most of the daily traffic runs on Independence Boulevard, the US 74 corridor lined with retail centers, car dealerships, offices, and restaurants. Sycamore Commons alone covers about 400,000 square feet with Costco, Lowe's, and Best Buy, and Windsor Square sits nearby. I-485 and NC 51 cross the town too, so customers from Mint Hill, Indian Trail, and south Charlotte reach Matthews shops in a few minutes. Harris Teeter also keeps its headquarters here.

Healthcare is the other big draw. Novant Health Matthews Medical Center, on Matthews Township Parkway, opened in 1994 and finished a four-story critical care tower in early 2025. It handles emergency, heart, stroke, surgical, maternity, and cancer care, and the town is building a 10-foot path along Matthews-Mint Hill Road from Trade Street to the hospital entrance. Doctors' offices, pharmacies, and therapy clinics that want those patients need to show up when someone searches from that end of town.

howWeWork.heading: How we work with Matthews businesses
paragraphs: We're Josh and Dave, and Creative Cowboys is based in Villa Rica, Georgia, on the west side of metro Atlanta. Matthews is a long drive from us, so the work runs on video calls and shared drafts. We learn your business on a call, build a version of the site you can click through, and adjust it from your notes.

There's no account manager in the middle. The two of us design the site, write the local pages, and run your SEO after it launches. When a visit to your shop or jobsite would help, we'll talk about making the trip.

faqs.q: How much does web design in Matthews, NC cost?
faqs.a: Most Matthews businesses start on our Local Marketing Package: $297 a month, month to month, no contract. It includes local SEO, paid ads management if you want ads (your ad budget is separate), and a custom website valued at $3,500 at no extra cost.

faqs.q: Can a Matthews business show up ahead of Charlotte companies?
faqs.a: For people searching in and near Matthews, it often can. Google leans on location for local searches. A site that clearly names the town and the areas you serve, backed by a complete Google profile and reviews from nearby customers, holds up well against Charlotte firms that list every suburb.

faqs.q: Should my site mention Mint Hill and Stallings too?
faqs.a: If you take work there, yes. Customers cross those town lines all the time, and a separate page for each area you really serve helps you show up there. We leave off places you don't cover, since those pages bring the wrong calls.

faqs.q: I'm a medical office near the hospital. What does my site need?
faqs.a: Clear service pages, the insurance you take, hours, directions, and a simple way to book or call. Patients usually look at two or three offices before deciding, so reviews and real photos of your staff and space matter a lot.

faqs.q: Do I need to meet you in person?
faqs.a: No. We're based in Villa Rica, Georgia, and most of the project happens over video calls and drafts you can review on your phone. If a sit-down would make the site better, we'll plan for it.

faqs.q: How long does a new website take?
faqs.a: Most sites launch in a few weeks. Speed depends mostly on how quickly we get your photos, service details, and feedback. We start the local SEO work at the same time, so your Matthews site goes live ready to be found.
